title: Belize prepares for current and future emergencies
limitations: Self-reported activities; pandemic support is not proof of climate-adaptation impact.

title: Belize's wildfires: Indigenous leadership for climate resilience
temporal_coverage: May 2024 wildfires and subsequent community response.
methodology: Staff account with Maya community-leader testimony.
limitations: Qualitative local reporting; no independent event-attribution or causal evaluation.

title: Resilience and conservation in a changing climate: The case of Belize
temporal_coverage: Marine conservation and adaptation activities reported in 2021.
methodology: Implementer feature describing ecosystem and livelihood interventions.
limitations: Reported outputs and testimony are not independent long-term livelihood or peace outcomes.

title: Climate Risk Profile: Belize
temporal_coverage: 2025 profile; mixed historical observations, projections and community assessment findings.
methodology: Desk research and community participation across selected protected-area landscapes.
limitations: Selected CAPA sites; qualitative conflict pathways are unquantified.

title: CORVI: Measuring Multidimensional Climate Risks in Belize City, Belize
temporal_coverage: Assessment published January 2025; includes expert views and data collected through December 2024.
methodology: CORVI combines desk research, 93 expert surveys and 20 interviews.
limitations: Expert-scored Belize City case study; not national or causal.

title: United Nations Belize Common Country Analysis 2021
organization: United Nations Belize, Office of the Resident Coordinator
temporal_coverage: 2021 country analysis; underlying indicators and events span multiple source periods.
methodology: Joint UN analysis; thematic groups scored risks by probability and development impact and consulted stakeholders.
limitations: Dated 2021 analysis; risk ratings and program statements are not measured outcomes.

title: Belize Second National Communication to the Conference of the Parties of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
organization: Government of Belize, Ministry of Natural Resources and the Environment
temporal_coverage: Prepared 2009 and edited through May 2012; includes projections for 2028, 2050 and 2100 and regional water assessments.
methodology: Government sector assessments using climate models and sector studies.
limitations: Old projections and observations; not current measurements.
